With Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability ({1}{W}{B}: Whenever you gain life this turn, each opponent loses that much life), giving Serra Avatar lifelink would mean dealing 71 combat damage, gaining 71 life, and then each opponent losing 71 life - which would kill the remaining opponent Llama4 Stoic at 41 life. Instead, they chose the first ability (just lifelink) without activating the second ability first, missing the lethal combo.
annotations.actionTaken: Activated Vizkopa Guildmage's first ability (give lifelink) without first activating the second ability (life gain causes opponents to lose that much life).
annotations.betterLine: Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability first ({1}{W}{B}: Whenever you gain life this turn, each opponent loses that much life), THEN activate the first ability to give Serra Avatar lifelink. Attack with Serra Avatar for 71 damage, gain 71 life, and Llama4 Stoic loses 71 life from the triggered ability - lethal on the only remaining opponent.
